query:
SELECT 
  fc.empresaSlug as unidade,
  c.categoriaRanking as categoria,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fc.colaboradorId) as profissionais_com_faturamento,
  ROUND(AVG(fc.totalGeral), 2) as media_faturamento,
  ROUND(MIN(fc.totalGeral), 2) as menor,
  ROUND(MAX(fc.totalGeral), 2) as maior,
  ROUND(AVG(c.metaMensal), 2) as meta_media
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId
WHERE fc.mes = 5 AND fc.ano = 2026 AND fc.tenantId = 1
GROUP BY fc.empresaSlug, c.categoriaRanking
ORDER BY fc.empresaSlug, c.categoriaRanking;
